title: Eval suite
description: Settings shared by every case, stored as evals/suite.json. Cases and graders are versioned together by version.

version.description: Bump when any case or grader changes. Scores from different versions are not comparable.

reps.description: Trials per case. One trial has no error bar.

caseTimeoutSeconds.description: Hard wall-clock ceiling per attempt, independent of stream liveness. A timeout is an error, not a zero.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts per trial when a transient error happens. Every attempt counts toward cost.

metrics.description: How each grader id is aggregated. Keys are grader ids from the cases. A grader with no entry uses mean over reps and mean over cases.

holdout.description: Random split, stratified by tags[0]. Never choose it by score.

model.description: Must differ from the model under test.

calibrationAgreement.description: Agreement with human labels on clear-cut cases, measured when the judge prompt was last changed.

perCase.description: How the reps of one case combine. mean: average pass rate. all: every rep must pass (consistency, pass^k). any: one passing rep is enough (pass@k).

overall.description: How cases combine. mean: pass rate. all: every case must pass, for rare high-stakes behavior where an average hides the failure.

regressionTolerance.description: Largest drop in the aggregate against the baseline that is still accepted. Keep it above the noise floor.
